user.title: Connect to LG Picture Bridge
user.description: Requires LG Picture Bridge 0.13.2 or newer. Enter the MQTT base before /command. The TV owns profiles; Home Assistant provides brightness sliders, day/night context and complete backups. Setup works while the TV is off.

error.invalid_topic: Use the bridge base topic without wildcard characters or a command suffix.
error.bridge_change: Add a separate integration entry to manage a different bridge.

abort.already_configured: This TV bridge is already configured.

init.description: Edit saved brightness with this integration’s three SDR brightness sliders. No separate helpers are needed.
